limits: Joined, physical and styled captures are sequential and metadata is read earlier in each sample; they are not simultaneous.
Joined rows cannot be mapped to physical cursor rows. Missing metadata/style fields remain unavailable.
A matching physical row or dim flag does not prove actual input, suggestion text or a menu.
The failed receipt remains failed regardless of later ACK or genuine work claims.
No exact input actions or submission deadline are exposed by these external captures.
